instrument: Breach prediction, paper test (design review F-04, F-47; cheapest test 3)
status: Proposed values; no participant has taken it.

model.wall: T3, the standard stone section: 8 m long, 2 m thick, 7 m high (5 m solid and 2 m of crenellation), 96 voxels of masonry
model.neighbors: one column of each neighbouring section, intact, so support runs into them as it would along a wall line
model.ground: y 0 bedrock, y 1 common rock, y 2-3 earth; the wall's lowest row stands on the earth at y 4
model.aprons: 7 m of ground on each side of the wall
model.axes: x along the wall, left to right as seen from outside; y up; z from outside to inside

views.front: rows top first, y 10 down to y 0; columns x 0-9, where 0 and 9 are the neighbouring sections; near is the outer layer, far the inner
views.top: rows inside first, z 15 down to z 0; heights are metres above the ground's surface

scoring.note: chanceMedianPasses[participants][perItemAccuracy]: each participant answers each item right with that probability, independently.
